title: Large Means Left: Political Bias in Large Language Models Increases with Their Number of Parameters

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with 38 political statements from the German Wahl-O-Mat tool, recording their agreement (Yes/Neutral/No), and calculating an alignment score with German political parties to determine their positioning on a left-right political axis.

Comparing the models' political alignment scores, response distributions, and tendency toward neutrality when prompted with the Wahl-O-Mat statements in their original German versus English translations.
